name: US retailer aggregate (Newegg/Best Buy/B&H) via GPU PRIX price page for nvidia-rtx-5090-laptop
notes: Mobile GB203 part, 24 GB GDDR7: it is never sold as a bare GPU, so the only buyable 'price' is the cheapest new laptop containing it ($3,299 low across tracked US retailers). Do not compare this to desktop card prices as if it were a drop-in accelerator.
